Title: Public Preview: Azure SQL updates for mid-March 2024

Body.Content:
In mid-March 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:

  • Zone redundancy can now be enabled for Azure SQL DB Hyperscale - Named Replica.
  • Improve the resiliency of your General Purpose  Azure SQL Managed Instances by upgrading to a zone-redundant configuration.
Body.Markdown:
In mid-March 2024, the following updates and enhancements were made to Azure SQL:

Zone redundancy can now be enabled for Azure SQL DB Hyperscale - Named Replica.

Improve the resiliency of your General Purpose Azure SQL Managed Instances by upgrading to a zone-redundant configuration.
